observations.statement: A one-sided SAT anti-checker needs only satisfiable false negatives, whose errors are certified by ordinary assignments; requiring false positives adds an unnecessary unsatisfiability-certificate obligation.
The one-sided repair does not solve uniform diagonalization: a constructor may not call SAT or circuit equivalence to locate false negatives.
The H035 Extended-Frege route is sufficient once one explicit computable potential has a polynomial one-step Lipschitz bound and a superpolynomial gap on transparently equivalent endpoints.
A finite added-gate chain auditor can validate artifact semantics and accounting but cannot establish the universal rewrite relation or an asymptotic distance lower bound.
Exact equality of rooted signed-neighborhood multisets is stronger than high girth or statistical similarity and is the minimum local object needed to attack the fixed ancestry radius of H106.
Local type equality alone does not determine global low-treewidth assembly; H115 must separately control finite interpretation semantics, decomposition choice, and recovery information.

C015 prioritizes three funnels only: rewrite distance to Extended Frege lower bounds, one-sided SAT anti-checkers to nonuniform lower bounds, and local indistinguishability to restricted compiler impossibility.
After C015, the inventory is expected to contain 103 live hypotheses and 12 terminal historical nodes; inventory is not a completion percentage.
